## Walkthrough This PR introduces a new `VersionRelease` type system to represent bundle versions with semantic versioning and release identifiers, updates bundle comparison and substitution logic to use this new type, refactors the declarative-config write logic for per-package organization, adds structured JSON/YAML output to the validation command, and updates Go dependencies across three modules. ## Changes **Version Release Type System & Bundle Version Inference** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| |**Release and VersionRelease types**
`staging/operator-registry/alpha/model/versionrelease.go`, `staging/operator-registry/alpha/model/versionrelease_test.go`|New `Release` and `VersionRelease` types combine semver versions with optional release identifiers. `Release` serializes as period-delimited strings with JSON support; `VersionRelease` provides semver ordering, comparison, and `KubernetesSafeString()` for DNS1123-safe output. `NewRelease()` validates and parses release strings with segment constraints.| |**Bundle VersionRelease extraction and legacy conversion**
`staging/operator-registry/alpha/declcfg/declcfg.go`, `staging/operator-registry/alpha/declcfg/legacy_releaseversion_test.go`|`Bundle.VersionRelease()` extracts the single `olm.package` property and converts it to the new type. `Bundle.usesLegacyReleaseVersion()` detects legacy bundles via `olm.substitutesFor` annotation (checked in `CsvJSON`, `olm.csv.metadata`, or `olm.bundle.object`). For legacy bundles, semver build metadata is converted into the release identifier. Re-exports `Release`, `VersionRelease`, and `NewRelease` in declcfg.| |**Model conversion to new release type**
`staging/operator-registry/alpha/declcfg/declcfg_to_model.go`, `staging/operator-registry/alpha/declcfg/declcfg_to_model_test.go`|`ConvertToModel` now uses `model.NewRelease()` to parse bundle release strings instead of semver pre-release construction. Updated test assertion expects detailed error messages from the new release parser.| **Bundle Ordering & Substitution Validation** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| |**Bundle comparison via VersionRelease**
`staging/operator-registry/alpha/declcfg/declcfg.go`|`Bundle.Compare()` now constructs and compares `VersionRelease` values instead of using the prior `CompositeVersion` approach, enabling semantic version ordering with release identifiers.| |**Substitution validation using VersionRelease**
`staging/operator-registry/alpha/template/substitutes/substitutes.go`, `staging/operator-registry/alpha/template/substitutes/substitutes_test.go`|`validateSubstitution()` compares bundles via `VersionRelease()` instead of `CompositeVersion()`, rejecting substitutions where the base release is not strictly greater than the substitute. Updated error messages and test assertions reflect the new comparison semantics.| **Declarative Config Write Refactoring** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| |**Per-package configuration grouping and output**
`staging/operator-registry/alpha/declcfg/write.go`, `staging/operator-registry/alpha/declcfg/write_test.go`|New `configsByPackage()` helper groups packages, channels, bundles, others, and deprecations by package name, separating root-level "Others" with empty package names. `writeToEncoder()` and `WriteFS()` now iterate over grouped configurations, writing per-package `catalog` files and optionally a root `catalog` for root-level Others. Added validation that package names are single path elements. New `TestWriteFS` verifies round-trip equality after writing and reloading grouped configurations.| **Validation Structured Output** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| |**JSON/YAML output support for validation**
`staging/operator-registry/cmd/opm/validate/validate.go`|`NewCmd` now accepts `--output/-o` flag (json\|yaml) to format validation results as structured `ValidationResult` with `Passed` status and optional error details. When output format is specified, results are marshaled and written to stdout while validation errors are returned cleanly; otherwise retains original `logger.Fatal` behavior. Adds `ValidationResult`, `ValidationError` types and `errorToValidationError` helper.| **Dependency Updates** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| |**Go module dependency version bumps**
`go.mod`, `staging/operator-lifecycle-manager/go.mod`, `staging/operator-registry/go.mod`|Updated `grpc-health-probe` to `v0.4.49`, `operator-registry` to `v1.68.0`, `protoc-gen-go-grpc` to `v1.6.2`, `docker/cli` to `v29.4.3+incompatible`, OpenTelemetry exporters to `v1.43.0`, and multiple `golang.org/x/*` and `google.golang.org/genproto` indirect dependencies to newer versions across all three module files.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes ## Possibly related PRs - [openshift/operator-framework-olm#1291](https://github.com/openshift/operator-framework-olm/pull/1291): Related change that removes derived-release derivation from substitutesFor/buildMetadata, contrasting with this PR's introduction of legacy release version conversion logic. ## Suggested labels `verified` ## Suggested reviewers - ankitathomas - perdasilva

staging/operator-registry/cmd/opm/validate/validate.go (1)
`63-83`: _⚡ Quick win_ **Fail fast on invalid `--output` before running validation.** Line 64 runs `config.Validate(...)` even when Line 82 will reject an invalid format. Validate `output` first so bad flag values fail immediately.
Proposed change ```diff RunE: func(c *cobra.Command, args []string) error { + if output != "" && output != outputJSON && output != outputYAML { + return fmt.Errorf("invalid --output value %q, expected (json|yaml)", output) + } + directory := args[0] s, err := os.Stat(directory) if err != nil { return err } @@ - switch output { + switch output { case outputJSON: data, marshalErr = json.MarshalIndent(result, "", " ") case outputYAML: data, marshalErr = yaml.Marshal(result) - default: - return fmt.Errorf("invalid --output value %q, expected (json|yaml)", output) } ```
Also applies to: 111-111
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. In `@staging/operator-registry/cmd/opm/validate/validate.go` around lines 63 - 83, The code calls config.Validate(c.Context(), os.DirFS(directory)) before checking the --output flag, so invalid output values are only discovered after expensive validation; fix by validating the output flag first (check the output variable against outputJSON/outputYAML and return the "invalid --output value" error if it's not one of them) and only then run config.Validate and build the ValidationResult; apply the same reorder/early-check for the other similar output-handling site that produces a ValidationResult (the second occurrence using output/outputJSON/outputYAML). ```
staging/operator-registry/alpha/declcfg/legacy_releaseversion_test.go (1)
`167-234`: _⚡ Quick win_ **Add a regression case for mixed `olm.bundle.object` ordering.** Please add a case where the first bundle object is decodable but lacks `olm.substitutesFor`, and a later one contains it. This locks in order-independent detection behavior.
